listings.name: Alchemy

listings.name: Helius

listings.name: Jupiter
listings.freeTier: Free: $0 plan. The comparison table lists 1 req/s with unlimited credits; the $0 plan summary on the same page lists 25M credits and 10 req/s.

rest.notes: Swap quotes work keyless at 0.5 requests/sec; the free keyed tier allows 1 request/sec.

listings.chains: Solana

mcp.notes: Trading MCP: quotes and swaps on Solana.

listings.notes: The pricing page disagrees with itself; 1 req/s is the conservative table value. A free API key is said to raise limits.

listings.name: Uniswap trading API
listings.freeTier: Free to use; each API key defaults to 6 requests per second.

rest.notes: The trading API is free to use with a key; default limit is 6 requests/sec.

listings.chains: Uniswap-supported EVM chains

listings.name: Privy
listings.freeTier: Developer: free up to 500 MAU, 50K signatures and $1M transaction volume/month.

websocket.notes: Privy documents webhooks for real-time wallet notifications.

listings.name: Zerion API

mcp.notes: Docs and OpenAPI search only, not wallet data.

listings.notes: Decoded wallet transaction history, token prices and charts, and NFT holdings with collection floor prices and wallet NFT portfolio value. Free key is generated instantly, no approval needed. Paid: Builder $149/mo, Startup $499/mo; USDC accepted.

listings.name: 0x
listings.freeTier: Free Tier: about 5 req/s across endpoints, in fixed 1-second windows.

rest.notes: Free 0x API tier allows about 5 requests/sec with an API key.

websocket.notes: Current cross-chain quote streaming uses SSE; WebSocket was mentioned in the old private beta.

listings.chains: EVM; confirm in docs
listings.notes: Opening an SSE quotes stream counts as one request. Card requirement is not stated on the rate-limits doc.

listings.name: 1inch Business API
listings.freeTier: Dev Free: 100,000 calls/month, 60 req/min. x402 pay-per-call from $0.00018, $2 minimum USDC on Base.

rest.notes: Dev Free includes REST APIs: 100,000 calls/month and 60 requests/min.

websocket.notes: The Dev Free pricing table includes three WebSocket connections.

listings.chains: EVM; confirm networks in docs
listings.notes: Exceeding rate limits returns 429, not overage charges. Card payments are listed as coming soon.

listings.name: A402 Check API

rest.notes: Hosted GET mint summary, 20 requests per IP per day without a key.

listings.name: Across

listings.chains: Ethereum and supported L2s; confirm in docs
listings.notes: Intent-based bridge. The docs do not publish an API rate limit.

rest.notes: Sign-up grants 20,000 Developer Units; Allium's API Credits docs list REST wallet calls billed against them.

x402.notes: No key or signup: about $0.03 per wallet call in USDC, 3 req/s per wallet.

listings.notes: Also an analytics and data-warehouse platform. Signup needs a work email; personal email addresses are rejected.

listings.name: Alternative.me Fear and Greed Index
listings.freeTier: Free keyless Fear & Greed Index API; attribution required next to displayed data, including commercial use. No numeric rate cap published on this page.

websocket.notes: Official docs describe the HTTP index endpoint and image widget.

listings.chains: Market-wide
listings.notes: Endpoint: https://api.alternative.me/fng/. No daily cap is published.

rest.notes: Kava Cosmos LCD documents keyless GETs for account balances.

websocket.notes: WebSocket is Premium-only; both Public and Freemium are HTTPS-only.

mcp.notes: Agent RPC MCP: chain reads over Ankr RPC.

listings.name: Band Protocol

listings.chains: BandChain and supported consumer chains; confirm in docs

listings.name: Binance public market data

rest.notes: The public market-data REST host requires no API key.

websocket.notes: The public market-stream host is keyless; private user streams use a different host.

listings.chains: Binance venue markets
listings.notes: Public tickers, books, and klines do not need a key. Trading and account endpoints do. Exchange terms apply.

listings.name: Birdeye
listings.freeTier: Standard (free): 30,000 CUs, 1 rps, limited data access, no overage.

rest.notes: Standard includes a limited REST subset, 30,000 compute units per month, and 1 request per second.

websocket.notes: WebSocket starts at Premium in the documented plan comparison; Standard, Lite, and Starter exclude it.

listings.chains: Solana and other supported chains; confirm in docs
listings.notes: Send the API key in the X-API-KEY header.

websocket.notes: Live GraphQL subscriptions; pricing lists a 7-day trial with up to two concurrent streams.

listings.chains: 40+ indexed; 10 core real-time chains on self-serve
listings.notes: Archive history is not in the trial. Trial length in days is not restated on the pricing hero. Partner program is application-only.

listings.name: Blockchair
listings.freeTier: Free testing: 1,000 calls/day without an API key, for a few days; not documented as an unlimited-duration production tier.

rest.notes: Keyless REST testing: 1,000 calls/day for a few days.

listings.name: Blockscout

rest.notes: Free key: 5 requests/s and 100,000 credits/day; most REST calls cost 20 credits.

websocket.notes: Free-tier key works; 100 credits to connect, 10 per message. Disconnects when credits run out.

listings.chains: 100+ with one key
listings.notes: Get a key at https://dev.blockscout.com and call https://api.blockscout.com. Public explorer hosts can return a 403 bot challenge.

listings.name: Blockworks Data API

listings.chains: Multi-chain, including Solana and Hyperliquid; metrics vary by network.

listings.notes: Covers onchain activity, protocol fees and revenue, market data, fundraising, and token unlocks. Sign in to claim credits and get an API key. The public catalog is keyless, but queries for chain and asset data require a key.

listings.chains: Solana

mcp.notes: Documentation MCP only; it does not return routes or execute swaps.

listings.name: Chainalysis Sanctions Screening API

listings.chains: Crypto addresses; chain-agnostic screening
listings.notes: This is the sanctions screening surface, not the paid KYT or investigation suite. No official request cap is published.

listings.chains: Multi-chain feeds; confirm current list in docs

listings.chains: 70+ chains

listings.chains: Bitcoin
listings.notes: Excellent for Bitcoin fees, blocks, and addresses. Cache aggressively and do not hammer the public instance.

listings.name: Mobula
listings.freeTier: Free: 10,000 credits/month, 1 RPS. Keyless demo API (demo-api.mobula.io) for testing.

rest.notes: Free API key includes 10,000 monthly credits at 1 request per second, including wallet REST calls.

websocket.notes: WSS feeds are listed only on Growth and Enterprise, not Free or Start-up.

listings.chains: Multi-chain; confirm current list in docs
listings.notes: Also sells market and trading data.

listings.name: Moralis
listings.freeTier: No standing free Data API plan. Request a trial. Paid API starts at $149/month (2M CU, 40 RPS).

rest.notes: Data API has a request-only free trial and no self-serve free plan.

websocket.notes: The Wallet Data API uses REST. WebSocket is documented for the separate RPC Nodes product.

listings.chains: All networks on API plans
listings.notes: Data Feeds Starter is $10/month and does not include the Data API. The 30% lifetime offer is for Moralis Money, not this API.

listings.name: Nansen
listings.freeTier: Free: 100 one-time trial credits; thereafter a daily top-up restores included balance to 10 credits if below 10 (not an additive 10/day grant).

rest.notes: Free plan starts with 100 credits, then tops up the included balance to 10 daily if lower.

listings.chains: 38 networks including Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, BNB Chain and Solana; 14 retire Nov 25, 2026, six more Feb 1, 2027
listings.notes: Research add-on for both analytics and wallet intelligence. Official handle is @nansen_ai. The @nansen account is a different person.

listings.name: Neynar
listings.freeTier: Free: 10M credits/month, 600 RPM per endpoint, 1,000 RPM global, 10 webhooks, 5 apps (confirmed; Starter/Growth plans no longer sold, next tier Scale $249/mo)

rest.notes: Free includes read/write APIs, 10M credits/month and 600 requests/min per endpoint.

websocket.notes: Real-time guides document webhooks and hub gRPC streaming, not WebSocket.

listings.chains: Farcaster, plus Ethereum and Solana address enrichment

mcp.notes: Docs-search MCP for building with Neynar, not a data-query MCP.

listings.notes: Rate limits and credits are independent. Card requirement is not stated. Context also on https://neynar.com/developer

listings.name: NOWNodes
listings.freeTier: Start: 100,000 requests/month, 1 API key.

rest.notes: Blockbook REST is included on Start; the NOWNodes FAQ says Start is free for one month.

websocket.notes: Keyless public WebSocket access is advertised; private WSS endpoints require a paid plan.

listings.chains: 120+ networks

mcp.notes: Docs, method discovery and request generation.

listings.notes: MCP Servers appear in the pricing table; Start inclusion was not clear. Affiliate: 5% crypto or 10% credit for 6 months, https://nownodes.io/affiliate-program

listings.name: OpenSea
listings.freeTier: Instant free-tier key, no signup: 600 reads/hour, 30 writes/hour, 5 fulfillments/min. Replace the key after 7 days.

rest.notes: Instant REST keys are free, expire after 7 days, and can be replaced with another free key.

websocket.notes: Marketplace stream accepts the instant key; API keys docs say to replace it after 7 days.

listings.chains: OpenSea-supported chains; confirm in docs
listings.notes: Mint via POST https://api.opensea.io/api/v2/auth/keys. Honour rate-limit headers; group limits can be tighter. OpenSea recommends a full key for higher-throughput production use.

listings.name: PublicNode
listings.freeTier: Free public RPC on 77 chains, no key or signup. Rate limits enforced (HTTP 429); numbers not published.

rest.notes: Cosmos has a keyless public REST endpoint.

websocket.notes: Cosmos has a keyless public WebSocket endpoint.

listings.chains: Many networks, including Ethereum, Solana, Polygon and Base
listings.notes: Operated by Allnodes. Useful as a backup public endpoint, not as a documented production SLA.

listings.name: Pyth
listings.freeTier: Free: sponsored push feeds on Ethereum, Solana, Sui, Optimism, Monad and others can be read onchain with no key, and update fees are 0. The Hermes API has required a Pyth API key since Aug 26, 2026, and free Hermes price API access is trial-only. Paid API plans start at $500/month.

rest.notes: Pyth Pro symbol lookup is keyless; Hermes price updates require a key from the trial or a paid plan.

websocket.notes: The Pyth Terminal trial key works for Pro WebSocket; the ongoing free plan has no streaming API access.

listings.chains: 100+ chains (EVM, Solana, Sui and more); sponsored push feeds on select networks
listings.notes: Pricing page: the Free plan is view-only in Pyth Terminal with no API access; Starter ($500/month) and Pro (from $2,500/month) include API keys. Pyth Pro has no hard rate limits; limits come from your subscription. Hosted MCP at mcp.pyth.network/mcp: feed search works without a key, price tools need a Pro key. Onchain contracts are permissionless.

listings.name: QuickNode
listings.freeTier: x402: 1M free API credits per wallet per month, shared with MPP. Standard RPC trial (1 month): 10M API credits, 15 req/s.

rest.notes: Cosmos LCD REST is available through a node endpoint; pricing lists a one-month trial.

websocket.notes: Ethereum node WSS subscriptions are available on the one-month trial listed on pricing.

listings.chains: 75+ chains, including Ethereum, Solana, Base and Bitcoin

mcp.notes: Manages QuickNode infrastructure (endpoints, usage); not a market-data MCP.

x402.notes: Each wallet gets 1 million free API credits per month, shared across x402 and MPP. A standard RPC call uses one credit; no QuickNode account or API key is required.

free.summary: x402: 1M free API credits per wallet per month, shared with MPP.

listings.name: RedStone
listings.freeTier: Free to read push feeds already deployed onchain (gas only). The pull model needs a RedStone API key for its gateway; no public free quota is published.

rest.notes: Pull-model gateway serves signed data packages over HTTP; API key required, pricing not stated.

websocket.notes: RedStone Live streams prices and signed packages over WebSocket; key required, pricing not stated.

listings.chains: Multi-chain; confirm in docs
listings.notes: Limits depend on the integration path: push feeds are read onchain, the pull model goes through the RedStone gateway.

listings.name: Relay
listings.freeTier: Default self-serve limits per App: quotes 50 requests/minute, requests 100/minute, and other listed endpoints 200/minute; the docs do not label these as a priced free tier.

rest.notes: Chain and currency metadata are keyless; swap quotes require an API key.

websocket.notes: Intent status WebSocket uses an API key; WebSocket pricing is not stated.

listings.chains: Major EVM chains plus Bitcoin, Solana, Tron, Eclipse, and more.
listings.notes: Cross-chain execution API.

listings.name: RIFT
listings.freeTier: Keyless cross-chain swap API: 1 request/second, no card. RIFT adds no fee; network and execution costs still apply.

rest.notes: HTTP quotes and orders work without an API key at 1 request/second; executing a swap requires funding the order.

listings.chains: Ethereum, Bitcoin, Base, Arbitrum, Polygon, Hyperliquid, Robinhood Chain, Ink, Plasma
listings.notes: Quotes show estimated execution costs. Integrators can optionally charge their own fee; contact RIFT for an API key for higher limits.

listings.name: Routescan
listings.freeTier: Free keyless: 2 requests/s, 10,000 calls/day; registered Free: 5 requests/s, 100,000 calls/day. Free RPC key: eth_* only, 1 RU/s and 86,400 RU/day.

rest.notes: Indexed data API: keyless 2 requests/s and 10,000/day; free key raises limits to 5/s and 100,000/day.

websocket.notes: Archive RPC is explicitly HTTP-only; Streams documents webhooks, queues and storage destinations.

listings.chains: EVM networks including Ethereum, Avalanche C-Chain, Mantle and FIFA Blockchain; coverage varies by product
listings.notes: Use @routescan_io, not the empty @RouteScan stub.

listings.name: SNS (Solana Name Service)
listings.freeTier: Free, no key: use the SDK with any Solana RPC, or the experimental REST proxy. No rate limit published.

rest.notes: SNS's experimental production REST proxy documents keyless domain, owner and record lookups.

listings.chains: Solana
listings.notes: Official X account is @sns (sns.sol). Bonfida historically built SNS; @bonfida still exists but is not the current official product handle.

listings.name: Socket / Bungee
listings.freeTier: Free. Public endpoint needs no key (shared limit, for testing). Free production key on request: 20 req/s.

rest.notes: Socket Swap V3 is keyless for testing and prototyping; production access is separate.

listings.chains: Multi-chain bridges and DEX routes supported by Socket; confirm in docs
listings.notes: Socket is the API; Bungee is the consumer app (official X: @BungeeExchange).

listings.name: Solscan
listings.freeTier: Free Level 1 key with a Solscan account: network and analytics endpoints plus a demo tool set, tight limits. Paid from $49/month.

rest.notes: Public chain-information REST endpoint is keyless; separate Pro endpoints use a key.

listings.chains: Solana
listings.notes: Use @solscanofficial. The bare @solscan handle was not found.

listings.name: SQD
listings.freeTier: Public Portal: free, no setup/key; 20 requests per 10 seconds. Published future Public plan: ~0.1 MB/s and ~50 MB/month; Testing: ~0.5 MB/s, ~1 GB/month, one chain. Billing is not live: future table is not the current enforced monthly quota. Non-commercial development/evaluation only.

rest.notes: Portal pricing lists a keyless, rate-limited Public plan for development and evaluation.

websocket.notes: Portal streams JSON Lines over HTTP; the separately self-hosted Spray client is not Portal.

listings.chains: 110+ networks: EVM, Solana, Substrate, Bitcoin, TRON, Hyperliquid
listings.notes: Formerly Subsquid.

listings.name: Subscan
listings.freeTier: No new direct free keys. New free access is via eligible PubFi :free routes, with per-route live free_rate_limit; no universal current numeric free quota published in Subscan docs.

rest.notes: Eligible Subscan routes are free with a PubFi key and :free suffix; new direct Subscan keys require a paid plan.

listings.chains: Polkadot, Kusama, and other Substrate networks Subscan supports

mcp.notes: Documentation MCP only, not an onchain data MCP.

listings.notes: New free access uses a PubFi Bearer key and eligible :free gateway routes; Subscan no longer issues new direct free API keys. Direct Subscan paid plans use X-API-Key on network-specific hosts; credentials are not interchangeable.

listings.name: Tatum
listings.freeTier: Free Plan: 100,000 lifetime credits, 3 req/s on full nodes, 2 API keys.

rest.notes: Tatum REST calls use credits; Pricing lists 100K lifetime credits on the Free plan.

websocket.notes: WebSocket messages use credits; the docs do not specify access on the Free plan.

listings.chains: Named networks in the RPC support matrix, including Ethereum, Bitcoin, Solana and Polygon
listings.notes: Partner program exists; public commission rate was not published. https://tatum.io/partner-program

listings.name: The Graph Subgraph Studio
listings.freeTier: First 100,000 monthly queries are free, then $2 per 100,000.

rest.notes: Studio exposes subgraph queries as GraphQL; the published Network query endpoint is GraphQL too.

websocket.notes: Subgraph subscriptions are unavailable on The Graph Network; Graph Node removed its WebSocket server.

listings.chains: 60+ networks

mcp.notes: Subgraph MCP: query subgraphs, not a general chain API.

listings.notes: This is Studio query billing, not a general RPC. Card requirement is not stated. Pay by card or crypto.

listings.name: TRONSCAN
listings.freeTier: An API key is required for Mainnet endpoints; keyless access is severely limited and not QPS-guaranteed. The numeric free-key quota is not published in the reviewed docs.

rest.notes: Shasta and Nile REST are keyless. Mainnet docs require a key for normal access; some calls remain rate-limited without one.

listings.chains: TRON

listings.name: UMA
listings.freeTier: Free: no API fees, key or signup. You post a bond plus gas when asserting data onchain; disputes are settled by UMA token holders.

rest.notes: Oracle interactions are onchain; UMA’s indexed data is available through a GraphQL subgraph.

websocket.notes: Oracle interactions are onchain; UMA’s indexed data is available through a GraphQL subgraph.

listings.chains: Chains the optimistic oracle supports; confirm in docs
listings.notes: Useful for resolution and verification, including prediction markets. It is not a price-tick REST API.

listings.name: Velora (formerly ParaSwap)
listings.freeTier: Free tier: 1 request per second and 5,000 requests per day; no API key or signup required.

rest.notes: Free REST tier allows 1 request/sec and 5,000 requests/day without a key.

websocket.notes: The market-maker WebSocket is hosted by the integrator, not Velora.

listings.chains: EVM chains supported by Velora; confirm in docs
listings.notes: ParaSwap rebranded as Velora. Use the current Velora docs and @VeloraDEX, not legacy ParaSwap-only materials, for limits.

listings.name: Webacy
listings.freeTier: Free Demo plan: 500 requests/month, 1 request/second, burst capacity 2; endpoint access depends on plan.

rest.notes: Free Demo API key: 500 requests per month, up to 1 request per second; endpoint access varies.

listings.chains: Confirm current chain list in docs
listings.notes: Wallet and address risk scoring.
